channel.title: US Top News and Analysis
channel.description: CNBC is the world leader in business news and real-time financial market coverage. Find fast, actionable information.

item.title: Dow rallies 600 points, boosted by strong earnings and a steep decline in oil: Live updates
item.description: Investors are bracing for a big week of mega-cap earnings and a Federal Reserve meeting.

item.title: U.S. Strategic Petroleum Reserve faces stress as emergency releases strain old infrastructure
item.description: The reserve has an authorized storage capacity of 714 million barrels, according to the Department of Energy.

item.title: Blurred front lines: Trump meets Zelenskyy as Ukraine, Iran wars collide
item.description: Trump and Zelenskyy meet as the U.S war against Iran and Russia's full-scale invasion of Ukraine have threatened to overlap in recent days.

item.title: Apple touches $5 trillion market cap for first time
item.description: The jockeying between Apple and Nvidia reflects a debate about the future of AI that has preoccupied investors this summer.

item.title: Shein says it's under investigation by the Federal Trade Commission as it prepares for Hong Kong IPO
item.description: Shein disclosed the FTC is investigating its U.S. business, but the nature of the probe is unclear.

item.title: Buy these durable stocks with better-than-expected earnings for a choppy stock market, says Wolfe
item.description: The stock market has been sailing through choppy waters in July, which could make stocks with stronger fundamentals more appealing for investors.

item.title: Visa is cutting 7% of employees in efficiency push as AI reshapes work
item.description: Visa plans to cut about 7% of its workforce, or roughly 2,600 employees, as CEO Ryan McInerney seeks to streamline the payments giant.

item.title: Apple plans to lease iPhones for $17.99 a month through partnership with Klarna
item.description: Apple is announcing an iPhone lease option weeks after raising iPad and Mac prices due to the global memory shortage.

item.title: EBay, former execs to pay $56 million in blogger harassment and stalking case
item.description: Ina and David Steiner run a popular ecommerce blog that had angered eBay executives due to its critical coverage.

item.title: Boeing posts wider loss than expected as Air Force One costs weigh on results
item.description: Boeing took a $280 million charge on its long-delayed Air Force One program.

item.title: Stocks making the biggest moves midday: Boeing, Amkor, Corning, Sandisk, Iqvia & more
item.description: Here are some of the companies making headlines in midday trading.

item.title: Major quake hits southern Japan, workers missing after mall blast
item.description: Prime Minister Sanae Takaichi said authorities were assessing the full extent of the damage in the area, which was devastated by a deadly quake a decade ago.

item.title: The future of Wall Street is here as startups and brokers build AI agents to trade 24/7
item.description: Brokerages, startups and even retail investors are building AI agents that can help oversee portfolios and automate investing tasks once handled by humans.

item.title: Under pressure over China backers, Mercedes CEO pledges to defend U.S. business
item.description: The U.S. Senate ⁠Commerce ‌Committee approved legislation last week to toughen a ban on ⁠Chinese automakers entering the U.S. market.

item.title: Iran hosts Hormuz calls with Saudi Arabia, Oman as Trump hails ‘good talks’
item.description: Talks over the Strait of Hormuz continue as Iran's Foreign Ministry discussed the strategically vital maritime passage with Saudi and Omani counterparts.

item.title: Ford Motor is set to report earnings after the bell. Here's what Wall Street expects
item.description: Wall Street analysts expect Ford to report adjusted earnings per share of 35 cents and automotive revenue of $45.86 billion.

item.title: Chip stocks head for one of their worst months ever. Is it a blip or the end?
item.description: In the run up to its March 2000 peak, the leading chip stock index saw many months of percentage losses comparable to the current monthly pullback.

item.title: Coca-Cola hikes full-year forecast. CEO tells CNBC the World Cup boosted its brands
item.description: Coca-Cola said demand for its drinks rose in every market in the second quarter, helped in part by the World Cup.

item.title: Meta likely to highlight smart glasses, avoid social media policy on upcoming earnings call, Kalshi traders say
item.description: The Facebook and Instagram owner is set to report earnings after the market close on Wednesday.

item.title: UPS expects third-quarter domestic revenue to be flat but CEO tells CNBC the company is through its 'bumps'
item.description: UPS beat Wall Street expectations and raised its full-year guidance in its second-quarter earnings report Tuesday.

item.title: We're buying the dip on one of our stocks for two key reasons
item.description: We don't see signs of a slowdown in the parcel delivery industry, and believe FedEx is stealing share from its rival UPS.

item.title: Student loan default is rising: 3 ways to start paying down your balance — even on a tight budget
item.description: You can put extra money toward your student loans by earning bank account bonuses, maximizing credit card rewards and negotiating down your monthly bills.

item.title: Analysis: Kevin Warsh has three reasons to hold off on a Fed rate hike this week
item.description: At the Fed’s July meeting, the new chairman will reveal how he weighs energy shocks, AI-driven price pressure, the task forces and pressure from Trump.

item.title: SpaceX stock-purchasing by Congress members fuels conflict concerns
item.description: Five of the Congress members serve on committees whose work touches SpaceX's federal contracts, defense programs, AI, telecommunications or securities markets.

item.title: Elevated energy prices, AI capex binge puts the Fed and Kevin Warsh in a tough spot
item.description: Fed Chairman Kevin Warsh and many of his devotees have argued that some short-term price pain can be tolerated in anticipation of AI eventually suppressing inflation.

item.title: New Republican ads slam Democrats opposed to Trump's tariffs
item.description: As the 2026 midterm elections approach, the National Republican Congressional Committee is knocking Democrats who have opposed President Donald Trump's tariffs.

item.title: Supreme Court approval hits record low as Republicans' support declines
item.description: The Trump administration saw some big losses at the Supreme Court in 2026 on issues involving tariffs, birthright citizenship and the Federal Reserve.

item.title: Lawmakers renew push to axe a lucrative tax loophole for crypto investors
item.description: Crypto investors have largely been exempt from the "wash sale" rules that apply to stocks and other traditional assets. Congress is trying to clamp down.

item.title: Meta, BlackRock partner on $14 billion El Paso data center venture
item.description: Meta shares have fallen about 10% so far this year, as investors scrutinize the costs of AI expansion. The company is scheduled to report earnings on July 29.

item.title: SpaceX has now lost the equivalent of a full Tesla in market capitalization
item.description: Elon Musk's space company has wiped off more than $1.2 trillion in market cap since hitting a high of $225.64 per share in June.
